In re Case of Mo Tsung Khe 

In my annual report under the heading of "Right 
of Appeal in Extradition Cases", I referred to the case 
of Mo Tsung Khe. The acoused in that case was arrested 
on May 10, 1931, upon application of the Public Safety 
Bureau. He was brought before the Court on May 11, 1931, 
at which time the Public Safety Bureau made its appli- 
cation in open court. The case was remanded from time 
to time until. July 18, 1931, at which time the Court 
ordered the accused to be handed over to the Public 
Safety Bureau for trial, although no prima facie case 
had been proved. The Council thereupon appealed in three 
ways, as is outlined in detail in my annual report. The 
case eventually went to the Supreme Court, which dismissed 
the Council's kang kao. The District Court then over- 
ruled the Council's other two appeals, whereupon the Muni- 
cipal Council appealed to the.High Court, which has sent 
the case back again to the District Court for further order. 
The reason given by the High Court for sending the case | 
back was because the judgment of the District Court was 


not properly dated. The Court "sidestepped" the real issue : 


involved.

Artiole 73 of the Code of Criminal Procedure pro- 
vides as follows: 

"The detention of an accused may not exceed 
two months during preliminary investigation and 
three months during trial; provided however, that if 
at the expiration of such period, necessity exists 
for continuance of detention, the Procurator or 
the Judge concerned shall move the Court for a 
ruling in the matter. 

Upon the filing of a motion as described in 
the above paragraph, the Court may extend the 
period of detention, but no such period shall exceed 
two months. During preliminary investigation, an 
extension may be allowed once only. 

Where upon the expiration of the period of 
detention the case has not yet been set for prose- 
cution or trial, the writ of detention shall be 
deemed to be rescinded.”

Special Branch dated August 16 on the attached file relating
to the arrest of a communist suspect named Mo Tseng Khe

view of this individual having been detained in custody for

Authorities failed to prove a prima facie case against him,
I am of the opinion that the judgment rendered on August 15,
1932 should not be questioned.

Mr T S Lee appeared for the Police.
Mr Zung Yung Ka appointed for the accused.

Judge :- It is the Prosecutor's duty to announce the grounds
for the prosecution against the accused.

Prosecutor :- The grounds are mentioned in detail in the
petition.

Accused :- I was previously engaged in the Ewo Cotton Mill.
Although a strike had taken place, I still carried on with my work.
There are many departments in the mill, and each one is supervised
either by a foreigner or Chinese. I was introduced to work in the
mill by my father, who had been employed there for 4 years, and left
on his own accord owing to sickness, and now he is a hawker. I was
working in the steel wire department, and the man in charge of this
department was named "Woo San Han", and he is now unemployed. There
were thousands of workers employed in the mill, so I cannot say if
there was another man there with the same name as myself. I came
to Shanghai with my father from Kiangsu. Although a strike did take
place, I was asked by the man in charge of my department to carry
on work as usual. I do not know a man named "Tang Ah Kyi" or "Wah
Deu Ah Sung". I came to Shanghai when I was 16 years of age. I can-
not read.

Witness Ding Zung Poo :- I am a representative from the Public
Safety Bureau. The late Commissioner named Zung' asked me to inves-
tigate whether there was a worker named Ho Tsung Khe employed in the
Ewo Cotton Mill, and from enquiries I found there was a worker of
this name, but I could not find out any information regarding the
strike, and also I did not find any proof for the reason of the strike

Judge :- I will remand the case again for further investigation

Decision. Remand ( no fixed date ) for trial pending production of
evidence.
J. B. Nash.

Proceedings
Mr. T S Lee appeared for the Police.
Mr. Van Kyl Sung appeared for the accused.

Procurator :- I ask the Court to try this case.

Accused :- I have been employed in the Ewo Mill for 6 years, as a labourer. I did not have anything to do with the Labourer's Union. I do not know if there is such a Union. I am not concerned in any Communist Party. I am not concerned in the affairs of the mill. I stopped work as the others workers stopped. I do not know anyone by the name of Yeu. I can only write my own name. I did not receive a letter from Yeu. I do not know Yang Ah Kyi or Woo. I have never seen the letter which is in the hands of the Court.

(Judge read over the letter to the accused)

Accused :- I do not know anything about the contents of the letter. I have never seen Woo. I was in Shanghai in 1927 but I never participated in any violent strike in that year. I do not know anyone by the name of Wang Doo San Wei.

Procurator :- This accused was implicated as a communist and same has been proved by evidence. I ask that he be punished.

Mr. Van :- The enquiries should have been open and the accused allowed to have a counsel.

Procurator :- The Procurator can institute prosecution against anyone after enquiries have been made. It is immaterial whether enquiries are made open or in private. The record of enquiries can be used in evidence.

Mr. Lee :- The evidence in this case is weak. The enquiries were not even according to Article 8 of the Rendition Agreement and the accused had no chance to engage a counsel. The accused has been in custody for ten months before prosecution was instituted.

Decision Pleadings concluded. 31.5.32. 1.30.P.M. for Judgment.

M.L.S.

In re Case of Mo Tsung Khe

In my annual report under the heading of "Right
of Appeal in Extradition Cases", I referred to the case
of Mo Tsung Khe. The accused in that case was arrested
on May 10, 1931, upon application of the Public Safety
Bureau. He was brought before the Court on May 11, 1931,
at which time the Public Safety Bureau made its appli-
cation in open court. The case was remanded from time
to time until July 18, 1931, at which time the Court
ordered the accused to be handed over to the Public
Safety Bureau for trial, although no prima facie case
had been proved. The Council thereupon appealed in three
ways, as is outlined in detail in my annual report. The
case eventually went to the Supreme Court, which dismissed
the Council's kang kao. The District Court then over-
ruled the Council's other two appeals, whereupon the Muni-
cipal Council appealed to the High Court, which has sent
the case back again to the District Court for further order.
The reason given by the High Court for sending the case
back was because the judgment of the District Court was
not properly dated. The Court "sidestepped" the real issue
involved.

Our right of appeal in extradition cases is one which
the Chinese will neither admit nor deny, and which we,
on the other hand, must continue to demand. The accused
has

秘书长，
上海工部局。

关于莫宗克案

在我的年度报告中，在“引渡案件中的上诉权”标题下，我提到了莫宗克案。该案的被告于1931年5月10日应公安局的申请被捕。他于1931年5月11日被带上法庭，当时公安局在公开法庭上提出了申请。案件多次延期，直到1931年7月18日，当时法庭命令将被告移交给公安局审判，尽管尚未证明存在初步成立的案件（prima facie case）。工部局随后以三种方式提出上诉，详情在我的年度报告中已有概述。案件最终上诉至最高法院，最高法院驳回了工部局的抗告（kang kao）。随后地方法院驳回了工部局的其他两项上诉，于是工部局向高等法院上诉，高等法院又将案件发回地方法院以作进一步裁定。高等法院将案件发回的理由是地方法院的判决书日期标注不当。法庭“回避”了所涉及的实际问题。

我们在引渡案件中的上诉权是中方既不承认也不否认的权利，而我们另一方面必须继续坚持这一权利。被告已

-2-

has now been detained for almost a year, and not a tittle
of evidence has been produced against him. If the case
is to continue, the accused will undoubtedly be held in
custody until the expiration of the present agreement,
which I think you will agree is most unfair.

Article 73 of the Code of Criminal Procedure pro-
vides as follows:

"The detention of an accused may not exceed
two months during preliminary investigation and
three months during trial; provided however, that if
at the expiration of such period, necessity exists
for continuance of detention, the Procurator or
the Judge concerned shall move the Court for a
ruling in the matter.
Upon the filing of a motion as described in
the above paragraph, the Court may extend the
period of detention, but no such period shall exceed
two months. During preliminary investigation, an
extension may be allowed once only.
Where upon the expiration of the period of
detention the case has not yet been set for prose-
cution or trial, the writ of detention shall be
deemed to be rescinded."

Under this section, it appears to me that the Council
cannot hold the accused any longer, for he is still under
investigation and no formal complaint has been laid. The
maximum period which the Court is entitled to detain the
accused would appear to be four months. If the accused
is detained any longer, he would have a right of action
against the Council in the Court of Consuls. I feel sure
that the accused is not going to bring such an action,
as he does not want to be handed over. He would rather
remain in our custody than be handed over to the Public
Safety Bureau. Nevertheless his further detention is
most unjust. I have filed an application with the Court
to have him released. Such application is in the nature
of a writ of habeas corpus. If the application is not
granted within one week after it is filed, I desire your
permission

-2-

此人现已被羁押近一年，而针对他的证据却未提出丝毫。若此案继续下去，被告无疑将被羁押至现行协议期满，我想你会同意这是极不公平的。

《刑事诉讼法》第七十三条规定如下：

“在预审期间，对被告的羁押不得超过两个月，在审判期间不得超过三个月；但如果在上述期限届满时，仍有继续羁押的必要，检察官或有关法官应向法庭申请就此事项作出裁定。
在提交如上段所述的申请后，法庭可延长羁押期限，但延长期限不得超过两个月。在预审期间，仅允许延长一次。
如果在羁押期限届满时，案件尚未提起公诉或开庭审理，则羁押令应视为撤销。”

根据该条款，在我看来，工部局不能再继续羁押被告，因为他仍处于调查阶段，且尚未正式起诉。法庭有权羁押被告的最长期限似乎是四个月。如果被告被进一步羁押，他有权在领事法庭对工部局提起诉讼。我确信被告不会提起此类诉讼，因为他不想被移交。他宁愿留在我们的羁押下，也不愿被移交给公安局。尽管如此，对他进行进一步羁押是极不公正的。我已向法庭提出申请，要求释放他。该申请的性质类似于人身保护令。如果申请在提交后一周内未获批准，我希望得到你的许可

permission to request the Police to release Mo Tsung
Khe without any further court proceedings.

You will recall several cases in the Provisional

IN THE KIANGSU SECOND BRANCH HIGH COURT

Shanghai Municipal Council
(Yangtzepoo Police Station).

Versus

Mo Tsung Khe

Kang Kao

Comes now the S.M.C. and kang kaos from the ruling (received
on March 30, 1932) rendered by the Shanghai First Special Area
District Court and dismissing the appeal and Sung Ming I Nyi filed
in the case in which application was made for handing over the
accused Mo Tsung Khe on suspicion of being a communist. The
reasons for the kang kao are as follows:

(1) Article 377, Section 1 of the Code of Criminal Procedure
is not applicable to a Sung Ming I Nyi.

The S.M.C., being dissatisfied with the decision rendered
by the Shanghai Special Area District Court on July 18, 1931 where-
by the accused Mo Tsung Khe was ordered to be handed over to the
Shanghai Public Safety Bureau, filed an appeal and a Sung Ming I
Nyi with the Kiangsu Second Branch High Court and the Shanghai
Special Area District Court respectively. According to the pro-
cedure, an appeal and a Sung Ming I Nyi are totally different.
Therefore, what is provided in law in respect of an appeal cannot
apply to a Sung Ming I Nyi. The original ruling which dismissed
both the appeal and Sung Ming I Nyi of the S.M.C. was rendered
in accordance with Art. 377, sec. 1 of the Code of Criminal Pro-
cedure. No matter whether Art. 337 of the Code of Criminal
Procedure is applicable to this case or not, the provisions con-
tained therein are in respect of an appeal only, and nothing is
mentioned therein about a Sung Ming I Nyi. Thus it is apparent
that a Sung Ming I Nyi is not subject to the provision of this
article. However, the Court of original trial applies the pro-
visions in respect of an appeal to a Sung Ming I Nyi. This does
not seem to be proper.

在江苏高等法院第二分院
案号 5/27718 站号 7750

上海工部局
（杨树浦警察局）。

诉

Mo Tsung Khe（音译）

Kang Kao（抗告）

上海工部局现就上海第一特区地方法院于1932年3月30日作出的驳回上诉及 Sung Ming I Nyi（声明异议）的裁决提出 Kang Kao（抗告），该案系申请因涉嫌为共产党分子而移交被告 Mo Tsung Khe（音译）。提出 Kang Kao（抗告）的理由如下：

(1) 《刑事诉讼法》第377条第1款不适用于 Sung Ming I Nyi（声明异议）。

上海工部局因不服上海特区地方法院于1931年7月18日作出的命令将被告 Mo Tsung Khe（音译）移交给上海公安局的裁决，分别向江苏高等法院第二分院和上海特区地方法院提出了上诉和 Sung Ming I Nyi（声明异议）。根据程序，上诉和 Sung Ming I Nyi（声明异议）完全不同。因此，法律中关于上诉的规定不能适用于 Sung Ming I Nyi（声明异议）。原裁决驳回上海工部局的上诉和 Sung Ming I Nyi（声明异议）是依据《刑事诉讼法》第377条第1款作出的。无论《刑事诉讼法》第337条是否适用于本案，其中包含的规定仅涉及上诉，并未提及 Sung Ming I Nyi（声明异议）。因此，显然 Sung Ming I Nyi（声明异议）不受该条款规定的约束。然而，初审法院将关于上诉的规定适用于 Sung Ming I Nyi（声明异议）。这似乎是不恰当的。

pages.en:
2

(2) The Court of original trial has no right to dismiss
the appeal in this case.
Being dissatisfied with the decision rendered by the Shanghai
Special Area District Court, the S.M.C. filed an appeal with the
competent superior court, i.e. the Kiangsu Second Branch High
Court. This is lawful according to the provision of Art. 358
of the Code of Criminal Procedure. There was no point of defect
in the appeal in this case so far as the procedure of law adopted
was concerned. Even if the Kiangsu Second Branch High Court con-
siders that the appeal is not well-grounded, the Kiangsu Second
Branch High Court should decide according to its own discretion,
and theCourt of original trial should not have acted in its
stead. However, the Judge who originally tried the case unmind-
fully dismissed the lawful appeal of the S.M.C. by misquoting
Art. 377 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. This does not seem
to be an act to uphold the law and there has not been such a pre-
cedent. Because of thefact that acts of arbitration on the part
of the court of original trial might be avoided, a lawful appeal
must be heard and decided by the competent superior court. If
the power of dismissing or sustaining an appeal rests with the
court which originally tried the case, then self-conceitedness
will predominate and not a single appeal out of a hundred would
be sustained by the Judge who was originally on the case. This
goes a long way from the intention of the legislature by which
the system of appeal was introduced and affects much the dignity
of law. This is the reason why the S.M.C. considers it improper
for the court of original trial to dismiss the lawful appeal in
this case.
(3) The Sung Ming I Nyi filed by the S.M.C. is not without
foundation in law and precedents can be quoted.
Art. 427 of the Code of Criminal Procedure provides:
"Where either of the measures described below taken by
the commissioned judge or the judge acting upon request is
the ground for complaint, application may be made to the court
pages.zh:
2

(2) 初审法院无权驳回本案的上诉。
上海工部局因不服上海特区地方法院作出的裁决，向有管辖权的上级法院，即江苏高等法院第二分院，提出了上诉。根据《刑事诉讼法》第358条的规定，这是合法的。就所采用的法律程序而言，本案的上诉没有任何缺陷。即使江苏高等法院第二分院认为上诉理由不充分，江苏高等法院第二分院也应自行酌情作出决定，而初审法院不应越俎代庖。然而，原审法官轻率地引用《刑事诉讼法》第377条，驳回了上海工部局的合法上诉。这似乎不是维护法律的行为，此前也无此先例。为了避免初审法院的仲裁行为，合法上诉必须由有管辖权的上级法院审理和裁决。如果驳回或维持上诉的权力掌握在初审法院手中，那么自负将占主导地位，原审法官维持的上诉百中无一。这与立法机关引入上诉制度的初衷相去甚远，并极大地影响了法律的尊严。这就是上海工部局认为初审法院驳回本案合法上诉是不恰当的原因。
(3) 上海工部局提出的 Sung Ming I Nyi（声明异议）并非没有法律依据，且有先例可循。
《刑事诉讼法》第427条规定：
“如果受委托法官或受托法官采取的下列措施成为申诉理由，可向该法官所属法院申请撤销或变更该裁定，但如果受托法官是地方法院法官，则应向有管辖权的地方法院提出申请：
    “(1) 涉及羁押、保释、扣押或归还扣押物品；”
上海工部局在本案中提出的 Sung Ming I Nyi（声明异议）是基于上述条款，具有法律基础。
    1930年，上海工部局也在上海公安局申请移交被告 Zung Yoong Shi（音译）的案件中提出了 Sung Ming I Nyi（声明异议），该案法官于1930年12月10日命令移交被告。高等法院分院作出裁定如下（民国十九年声字第二十七号）：
    “原命令撤销。调查案件证据并作出新命令。”
被告 Zung Yoong Shi（音译）被引渡的情况与本案类似，两案被告均因涉嫌犯有类似性质的罪行，且上海公安局提出的移交申请也相同。此外，上海工部局因不服法院命令移交被告而提出 Sung Ming I Nyi（声明异议）的原因完全相同。然而，在 Zung Yoong Shi（音译）案中，下级法院认定上海工部局提出的 Sung Ming I Nyi（声明异议）合法，并作出裁定，撤销原命令并另行作出命令。但在本案中，尽管有近期的先例，初审法院仍认定上海工部局提出的 Sung Ming I Nyi（声明异议）违反程序并予以驳回。此外，根据 Zung Yoong Shi（音译）案确立的先例，关于 Sung Ming I Nyi（声明异议）的裁定是由高等法院分院的三名法官作出的。然而，本案的裁定是由初审法官作出的

pages.en:
3

to which such judge belongs to have such ruling set aside or
altered, provided however, that in a case where the judge acting
upon request is a judge of the local court, such application
shall be made to the competent district court:
    "(1) Relating to detention in custody, bail, seizure, or
            restitution of things seized;"
The Sung Ming I Nyi filed by the S.M.C. in this case was based on
the article quoted above and was of legal foundation.
    In the year 1930 the S.M.C. also filed a Sung Ming I Nyi in the
case in which the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau applied for the
handing over of the accused Zung Yoong Shi and the judge on the case
ordered the accused to be handed over on December 10, 1930. A ruling
(No. 27, Character "Sheng", 19th year of the Republic) was rendered
by the District Court of Appeals as follows:-
    "Original order set aside. Evidence of the case to be investi-
        gated and a new order to be rendered."
The circumstances regarding the extradition of the accused Zung Yoong
Shi were similar to those in this case, the accused in both cases
being on suspicion of committing the offence of a similar nature and
the application made by the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau for handing
over being also the same. Furthermore, it was entirely for the same
reason that the S.M.C., being dissatisfied with the order of the
court for the accused to be handed over, filed the Sung Ming I Nyi.
However, in the case against Zung Yoong Shi the court below held
that the Sung Ming I Nyi filed by the S.M.C. was lawful and rendered
a ruling to the effect that the original order was to be set aside
and that another order was to be given instead thereof. But as re-
gards the Sung Ming I Nyi filed by the S.M.C. in this case, the court
of original trial held that it was contrary to the procedure and dis-
missed same although there was a precedent of a recent origin.. Fur-
thermore, according to the precedent as established in Zung Yoong
Shi's case, the ruling rendered in respect of the Sung Ming I Nyi was
made by the three judges of the District Court of Appeals. The rul-
ing in this case, however, was made by the judge of original trial
pages.zh:
3

所属法官有权撤销或变更该裁定，但前提是，如果应请求行事的法官是地方法院法官，则此类申请应向有管辖权的地区法院提出：
    “(1) 涉及羁押、保释、扣押或发还扣押物；”
本案中工部局提交的“声明异议”系基于上述条款，具有法律依据。
    1930年，在上海市公安局申请移交被告Zung Yoong Shi（音译）一案中，工部局亦提交了“声明异议”，承办该案的法官于1930年12月10日下令移交被告。地区上诉法院作出裁定如下（民国十九年声字第二十七号）：-
    “原裁定撤销。本案证据应予调查，并作出新裁定。”
被告Zung Yoong Shi（音译）的引渡情况与本案类似，两案被告均因涉嫌犯下性质相似的罪行，且上海市公安局提出的移交申请也相同。此外，工部局因不满法院下令移交被告而提交“声明异议”，其理由也完全相同。然而，在针对Zung Yoong Shi（音译）的案件中，下级法院认定工部局提交的“声明异议”合法，并作出裁定，撤销原裁定并另行作出裁定。但在本案中，尽管有近期的先例可循，初审法院仍认定工部局提交的“声明异议”违反程序，予以驳回。此外，根据Zung Yoong Shi（音译）案中确立的先例，对“声明异议”作出的裁定是由地区上诉法院的三位法官作出的。而本案的裁定则由初审法官作出

pages.en:
4
alone, which is apparently discordant with the precedent when a con-
trast is made. This is also a point of dissatisfaction on the part
of the S.M.C.
(4) The nature of an appeal, a Kang Kao and a Sung Ming I Nyi
is different in the law of procedure.
According to the notes taken at the trial the judge who tried
the case declared that although the S.M.C. appealed in three dif-
ferent ways (i.e. Shang Su, Kang Kao, and Sung Ming I Nyi), there
is no difference in regard to their nature. This is rather diffi-
cult for us to understand. According to the law of procedure, an
appeal, a Kang Kao and a Sung Ming I Nyi are different in their
names and forms and will therefore be of a different nature. Then
how can they be regarded as of the same nature? We would not
prate on the point as it is clearly specified in law.
Further, according to the notes taken at the original trial, the
judge declared that the S.M.C. appealed in three ways because it was
dissatisfied with the ruling of the court. This is quite right be-
cause the S.M.C. deems it as a judicial proceeding in this case.
Since it is a judicial proceeding there must be means of remedy ac-
cording to law for fairness' sake, no matter whether it is a measure,
an order or a ruling of the court. According to the rules of proce-
dure, there are only three kinds of appeal, i.e. Kang Kao, Shang Su,
and Sung Ming I Nyi. Of the three kinds of appeal at least one must
be sustained by the court. Nevertheless, the court regarded the Kang
Kao as contrary to the procedure and the appeal and Sung Ming I Nyi
as being without foundation in law. This only means that there can
be no remedy at all in this case.
In view of the foregoing reasons the S.M.C. feels confident that
they are entitled to appeal and Sung Ming I Nyi as well for legal
remedy according to law, the precedent and the principle of legis-
lature; for otherwise, there shall be no possibility of protecting
the interests of the party concerned and the whole community of the
International Settlement.
Wherefore it is hereby prayed that the original ruling be set
aside and that a new ruling be rendered so as to uphold the dignity
pages.zh:
4
这一点，在加以对比时显然与先例不符。这也是工部局感到不满的一点。
(4) 上诉、抗告与声明异议在诉讼法上的性质各不相同。
根据庭审笔录，审理该案的法官宣称，尽管工部局以三种不同方式（即上诉、抗告和声明异议）提出申诉，但其性质并无区别。这令我们难以理解。根据诉讼法，上诉、抗告和声明异议在名称和形式上均不相同，因此其性质亦应不同。既然如此，怎能将其视为同一性质？鉴于法律已有明确规定，我方对此不再赘述。
此外，根据初审庭审笔录，法官宣称工部局之所以以三种方式提出申诉，是因为其对法院的裁定不服。此言甚是，因为工部局视本案为司法程序。既然是司法程序，出于公平起见，无论法院采取的是措施、命令还是裁定，都必须有法律规定的救济途径。根据诉讼规则，申诉仅有三种，即抗告、上诉和声明异议。在这三种申诉中，至少有一种应得到法院的支持。然而，法院却认为抗告违反程序，而上诉和声明异议缺乏法律依据。这仅仅意味着在本案中根本没有任何救济途径可言。
鉴于上述理由，工部局确信，根据法律、先例及立法原则，其有权通过上诉及声明异议寻求法律救济；否则，将无法保护当事方及整个公共租界社区的利益。
为此，恳请撤销原裁定，并作出新裁定，以维护司法尊严

of the judiciary. All the reasons as set forth in the foregoing
paragraphs only tend to show that the appeal and Sung Ming I Nyi
in this case are not without foundation in the law of procedure.
With regard to the points in substantive law on which the S.M.C.
insists in the appeal and Sung Ming I Nyi filed by them, they
hereby ask for the right of reservation as they are not going to
disclaim same.

IN THE SHANGHAI FIRST SPECIAL AREA DISTRICT COURT
RULING
The appellant : Shanghai Municipal Council.
Counsel for the above: Mr. King S. Kum
The above-named appellant, being dissatisfied with the order
rendered by the Shanghai Special Area District Court on July 18,
1931, in the case in which the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau
applied for the handing over of one Mo Tsung Khe, filed an appeal
and a Sung Ming I Nyi. The ruling is hereby rendered by this
court as follows:
TEXT: Both the appeal and Sung Ming I Nyi are dismissed.
REASONS: According to the usual procedure, where a judgement
is considered to be inadequate an appeal may be filed, and where
execution is considered to have been improperly directed by the
procurator a Sung Ming I Nyi may be lodged. In this case the
Shanghai Public Safety Bureau asked the Shanghai Special Area
District Court to render assistance in effecting the arrest of one
Mo Tsung Khe. He was brought before the Court and ordered to be
handed over. This was only an order rendered by a judge acting
upon request. It was neither a judgment nor execution. Therefore
it was not in accordance with the procedure when appeal and Sung
Ming I Nyi were filed with this Court. This ruling is rendered
as per text above in accordance with Art. 377, Sec. 1 of the Code
of Criminal Procedure.
Read. March 30, 1932.
Judge : Shen Ping Yung.

上海第一特区地方法院
裁 定
上诉人：上海公共租界工部局董事会。

上述上诉人因不服上海特区地方法院于1931年7月18日在上海市公安局申请移交莫宗凯（Mo Tsung Khe）一案中所作出的命令，提起上诉及声明异议。本院现裁定如下：
正文：驳回上诉及声明异议。
理由：依照通常程序，若认为判决不当，可提起上诉；若认为检察官指挥执行不当，可提出声明异议。在本案中，上海市公安局请求上海特区地方法院协助逮捕莫宗凯。此人被带至法庭，并被命令移交。这仅是法官应请求而作出的命令。它既非判决，亦非执行。因此，向本庭提起上诉及声明异议不符合诉讼程序。本裁定系依据《刑事诉讼法》第377条第1款之规定，按上文正文作出。

the P.S.B, and hand him over but only on sufficient evidence.
The accused has been detained a long time and the proof produced to-
day is not satisfactory to the Police. I ask that the P.S.B. write
to the Central Headquarters and Hankow to produce sufficient evidence.

The following is the statement of Mo Tsung Khe
native of Tsingkiang taken by me D.S. Golder
at 12 noon on the 10-5-31 and interpreted by C.D.S.I.Phen Lien Pih

My name is 馬 振 愷 Mo Tsung Khe. I am aged 30, native of Tsingkiang,
residing at No.LL057 Tah Wo Ka, off Yangtszepoo Road. I first
came to Shanghai from the village of 吳 拉 Woo Tsung in the Hsien
of Tsingkiang in the Kiangsu province, at 16 years of age, when
I went to live at the 柏 兴 街 Mai Sing Ka, off Yangtszepoo Road. I came
to Shanghai with a friend of my father named "Tseu" 周 who has
since died and after arrival in Shanghai, I resided at the Mai
Sing Ka for about 2 years, when I went to live at 191 大 和 街 Tah Woo
Ka. I was married 7 years ago in my native place, and since I was
married, I have not left Shanghai. When I arrived in Shanghai,
I found work in the 東 方 紗 廠 Tong Foong Cotton Mill, Yangtszepoo Road,
I was employed there for one year and my next employment was
in the Ewo Cotton Mill, Yangtszepoo Road, when I stayed for 2
years, from there I went to Sih Yoong Iron Works, 瑞  铁 廠 Yangtszepoo
Road for 3 years, from here I went to the 恒 大 洋 行 Hung Dah Plumbing Works,
天主堂街 Ting Soo Tang Ka, Frenchtown, and after being there for
four years, I went back to the Ewo Cotton mill, where I have been
employed since. I have never been arrested by the police
before either here or in my native place. I have never written
to anyone in Hankow, the only letters I have written were
addressed to my relations in and around Tsingkiang. During my
youth, I went to school for a time between age 14 and 16, since
then I have received no education. I was introduced to the Toong
Foong and Ewo Mills by one Lee Sang Ching, 李 長 清 who was my tenant
living in the Mai Sing Ka. My other employment I obtained, Sih
Yoong Iron Works introduced by my father Mo Sze Sung, 馬 如 生. My father is
still alive and residing with me in the Tah Woo Ka. I have
never been a member of the communist party, nor have any dealings
with any of its members.

以下为莫宗凯（籍贯清江/镇江*）的供词，由我（侦探长 Golder）于1931年5月10日中午12时录取，并由华籍高级探员 Phen Lien Pih 翻译

*注：原文Tsingkiang通常指清江，但结合上下文Chinkiang(镇江)及音译，此处可能指镇江或其附近地区，档案原文拼写不一致，照实翻译为清江，但前文有Chinkiang。此处依原文Tsingkiang译作清江，或依当时习惯可能指镇江。鉴于前文出现Chinkiang，此处保留原文音译对应。*

我的名字是 馬 振 愷 Mo Tsung Khe。我今年30岁，籍贯清江（Tsingkiang），居住于杨树浦路大和街LL057号。我16岁时首次从江苏省清江县吴拉村（Woo Tsung）来到上海，当时我住在了杨树浦路柏兴街（Mai Sing Ka）。我是随我父亲的一位名叫“周”（Tseu）的朋友来上海的，此人现已去世。抵达上海后，我在柏兴街居住了约2年，随后搬到大和街191号居住。我7年前在老家结婚，自结婚以来，我未曾离开过上海。初到上海时，我在杨树浦路东方纱厂（Tong Foong Cotton Mill）找到了工作，在那里受雇一年，随后的工作是在杨树浦路怡和纱厂（Ewo Cotton Mill），在那里待了2年，之后我去了杨树浦路瑞铁厂（Sih Yoong Iron Works）工作了3年，从那里我又去了法租界天主堂街（Ting Soo Tang Ka）的恒大洋行水管工程处（Hung Dah Plumbing Works），在那里待了四年后，我又回到了怡和纱厂，并一直受雇至今。我以前无论是在这里还是在老家，都从未被警察逮捕过。我从未给汉口的任何人写过信，我写的信都是寄给清江及其周边地区的亲属的。年轻时，我在14岁至16岁之间上过一段时间学，此后便未再接受教育。我是通过李长清（Lee Sang Ching）介绍进入东方纱厂和怡和纱厂的，他是我住在柏兴街时的房客。我的其他工作机会，瑞铁厂是由我父亲马如生（Mo Sze Sung）介绍的。我父亲尚在人世，与我同住在大和街。我从未加入过共产党，也与其任何成员没有任何往来。
